crossRefs.note: “Dan will judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel.
Dan will be a serpent on the trail, an adder in the path, that bites the horse’s heels, so that his rider falls…
The border of the children of Dan went out beyond them; for the children of Dan went up and fought against Leshem, and…
There was a certain man of Zorah, of the family of the Danites, whose name was Manoah; and his wife was barren, and…
The woman bore a son and named him Samson. The child grew, and Yahweh blessed him.
Yahweh’s Spirit began to move him in Mahaneh Dan, between Zorah and Eshtaol.
Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on him, and he tore him as he would have torn a young goat with his bare hands, but he…
Yahweh’s Spirit came mightily on him, and he went down to Ashkelon and struck thirty men of them. He took their…
He struck them hip and thigh with a great slaughter; and he went down and lived in the cave in Etam’s rock.
He found a fresh jawbone of a donkey, put out his hand, took it, and struck a thousand men with it.
Samson said, “Let me die with the Philistines!” He bowed himself with all his might; and the house fell on the lords…
They took that which Micah had made, and the priest whom he had, and came to Laish, to a people quiet and unsuspecting…
Of the Danites who could set the battle in array: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.

people.name: Bashan
people.line: Region east of the Jordan, known for its fertility.

people.name: Dan
people.line: Israelite tribe; city in northern Israel; originally called Laish/Leshem.

translations.web: About Dan he said, “Dan is a lion’s cub that leaps out of Bashan.”
translations.bsb: Concerning Dan he said: “Dan is a lion’s cub, leaping out of Bashan.”
translations.kjv: And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion's whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.
translations.asv: And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion's whelp, That leapeth forth from Bashan.
